method: Static reverse engineering with rizin and independent reimplementation of decoded data; no sample was executed.

evidence.entry_and_control: main 0x1000aa9c initializes configuration via 0x1000f7e0; framed control traffic and timed task dispatch are present.
evidence.propagation: 0x1000cee4 constructs AF_INET port 23 at 0x1000d160 and connects through 0x1000c610; after prompt handling it sends router shell-entry commands via 0x10012bd4, beginning at 0x1000ee70.
evidence.process_termination: The propagation command builder reconstructs a shell script from seven escaped fragments. It enumerates /proc/*, reads /proc/$pid/exe, selects the (deleted) suffix, and sends SIGKILL. Native procfs process inspection is also implemented at 0x1000a1e4.
evidence.obfuscation: 0x1000f5d4 performs RC4-style KSA/PRGA with XOR swaps. Reproducing same-index zeroing decodes four configuration records using the 256-byte key at file offset 0x1892c.
evidence.limits: Decoded endpoints establish configuration, not observed contact. HTTP/JSON and HTTP2 strings alone are not evidence of benign purpose or actual protocol use.

samples.marker_line: Mirai PowerPC bot: clarify RC4 variant; retain propagation detections

evidence.entry_and_persistence: WinMain 0x401cb0 reads mode 3 at 0x404120 and calls 0x401900. This branch creates an Active Setup key and writes StubPath at 0x401a4b, reads its own image at 0x401a69, patches it, writes a clone at 0x401b26 and launches it.
evidence.injection: 0x401150 creates a target process, allocates and writes a DLL path into that process, resolves LoadLibraryA using GetProcAddress, and passes that export and remote buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
evidence.service_hijack: 0x401260 opens HKLM SYSTEM/CurrentControlSet/Services/LanmanServer/Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL, and rewrites it to the staged DLL path. The resource-extraction branch calls this only after extraction succeeds.
evidence.self_delete: 0x401390 obtains the current image path and its short form, builds COMSPEC /c del with that path, and creates the cleanup process.
evidence.damage: The entire 40960-byte .rsrc raw region is zero. FindResourceA in 0x402460 therefore cannot supply the expected DLL. Several code regions are also erased. Findings describe retained code, not a successfully installed service, functioning DDoS payload, or ransomware.
evidence.identity: StormServer.dll and Storm ddos Server/Welcome to use storm ddos banners corroborate the injector lineage. The collector filename is not evidence of WannaCry. No file-encryption or ransom behavior was established.

evidence.entry_and_propagation: main 0x80514f0 starts the scanner through 0x80557c0. Scanner 0x8053710 fetches a credential list at /creds via HTTP helper 0x8053040, builds target sessions and sends credentials and router commands. Calls at 0x8055666, 0x805569f and 0x80556d8 send enable, system and shell via socket send wrapper 0x8057b5d.
evidence.activation: 0x80543b9 loads the BusyBox chmod/local-execute command and 0x80543c2 sends it over the target socket. Alternate wget, TFTP, FTP and curl stages and writable-directory probing are implemented.
evidence.process_termination: 0x8054662, 0x80546db and 0x8054780 load the BusyBox echo prefix in the fragment emitter. The seven hex-escaped fragments decode to the same /proc deleted-image SIGKILL script as the PowerPC build.
evidence.suffix_merging: The read-only command table contains enable NUL system NUL linuxshell NUL. shell is referenced at 0x805c969 inside linuxshell, and sh at 0x805ca18 inside a different string. The old matcher required separate shell/sh storage and missed the actual send path.
evidence.obfuscation: 0x8050970 performs a four-byte unrolled RC4 transform with GET/dlr. as its key. The separate configuration transform at 0x8055950 uses XOR swaps and a 256-byte key at file offset 0x15100; reproducing the instructions decodes the same four records as PowerPC.
evidence.limits: Neither crypto fingerprint establishes malicious intent by itself. Both new capability traits are notable and restricted to x86 ELF .text.
